items.anchor_event: effective date of the Novation Agreement
items.description: Google must offer each Fluidstack Strategic Customer with property remaining in the Tenant Space a transition period to access and use the space, subject to entering into a transition access agreement.
items.span_text: Google will offer such Fluidstack Strategic Customer(s) a transition period equal to the shorter of: (i) 12 months or (ii) the remainder of the initial term of the Lease to access and use the Tenant Space
items.trigger: if any Fluidstack Strategic Customer has property remaining in the Tenant Space at such time

items.anchor_event: Akela’s planned termination of the Fluidstack Lease
items.description: Akela must give Google written notice of the Fluidstack Event of Default and its intent to terminate at least thirty days before the planned termination.
items.span_text: Akela will provide Google with written notice of such Event of Default and such intention at least thirty (30) days prior to Akela’s planned termination of the Fluidstack Lease.
items.trigger: In the event that (i) there is an Event of Default by Fluidstack under the Fluidstack Lease without the occurrence of a FS Default Trigger and (ii) Akela intends to terminate the Fluidstack Lease on the basis of such Event of Default

items.description: Google may, but need not, elect the Google Assumption Option by written notice to Akela within thirty days after Akela's notice.
items.span_text: Google will then have the option (but not the obligation), by written notice of the same to Akela within thirty (30) days after such written notice from Akela, to elect the Google Assumption Option.

items.description: Google must pay Akela the unpaid Rent under the Fluidstack Lease that is due as of the Deferral Option election, plus additional unpaid Rent during the Deferral Period.
items.span_text: Google agrees to pay to Akela (i) all Rent under the Fluidstack Lease that is due and owing that Fluidstack has not paid as of the date of such election
items.trigger: In the event that Google has elected the Deferral Option

items.description: Akela must use commercially reasonable efforts, including litigation, to pursue Fluidstack for full payment of the Unpaid FS Amounts.
items.span_text: Akela agrees to use commercially reasonable efforts to pursue Fluidstack for the payment in full of any Unpaid FS Amounts, including through litigation, until the Unpaid FS Amounts are paid in full

items.description: Amounts recovered from Fluidstack for Unpaid FS Amounts must be paid to Google to reimburse its payments to Akela.
items.span_text: Any amounts recovered from Fluidstack in respect of the Unpaid FS Amounts shall be paid to Google in reimbursement of the amounts paid by Google to Akela.

items.description: Notices under the Agreement must be in writing and delivered by hand, overnight courier, or e-mail with a confirming courier copy.
items.span_text: Any notice which may or shall be given under the provisions of this Agreement shall be in writing
